players.name: Master Ritualist Vera
goals: Perform proper ritual with all safeguards and offerings
Demonstrate correct technique with no corruption risk

scenario.situation: You're in a secure, properly warded ritual chamber with all necessary equipment and materials. Your void corruption is at a manageable 4/10. You have full ritual offerings, proper tools, protective wards, and extensive training. You'll perform a standard divination ritual using proper technique: laying protective wards, consuming offerings, following all protocols. This is textbook ritual work with no shortcuts - exactly how it should be done to avoid any corruption risk.

mission_objectives.description: Perform a proper divination ritual with all safeguards

_test_notes.purpose: Test void score NEUTRAL (no change) from properly executed ritual
expected_void_changes: Round 1: Prepare ritual space, lay wards, set up offerings → no void change
Round 2: Complete ritual with offerings consumed properly → no void change

verification.player_void_should_stay_same: Player should stay at void 4/10 (no increase despite ritual work)
verification.void_changes_should_be_null_or_zero: effects.void_changes should be empty list (no void events) OR amount=0
verification.proper_execution_prevents_corruption: Having offerings, tools, proper training, and following protocol = no void corruption

_test_notes.character_design: High skills (7-8), low risk tolerance, full equipment → maximizes success with no corruption
